Source: API Card
api: OSSL_STORE_load
library: openssl
family: der_store_loader
signature: OSSL_STORE_INFO *OSSL_STORE_load(OSSL_STORE_CTX *ctx)
parameter_semantics: ctx: store loading context created by OSSL_STORE_open_ex or related helpers
return_value_semantics: success: returns one OSSL_STORE_INFO object
end_or_failure: returns NULL; caller checks OSSL_STORE_eof and OSSL_STORE_error
valid_invalid_ranges: valid: supported object stream content
invalid: malformed object stream or unsupported object type
unsupported_conditions: - single-object callers that stop after first object without EOF/error policy
mutation_hints: - valid DER followed by malformed ASN.1 tail
- valid object followed by unsupported object
- malformed second object
- oversized trailing length
oracle_observables: - object_returned
- store_eof
- store_error
- caller_accept
notes: - 'Known pitfall: object-stream semantics can be safe for stream callers but risky
  for single-object app helpers.'
